name: Congregation Field Service Group Kit

New installer: double-click 설치.cmd / 설치.command, no Node.js pre-install (portable runtime downloaded on first run)

Local web installer (9 screens): Google sign-in → Firebase project/Firestore/web app/config auto, service-account key auto, Cloudflare sign-in → Worker+secret+Pages deploy, verification, resume on re-run
Fixes: Worker secret FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT now set during install; firestore.rules BOM removed; editor group order follows Firestore groups
Runtime config web/dist/config.js (no rebuild per congregation), prebuilt web/dist bundled
업데이트.cmd / 업데이트.command: fetch latest kit, keep settings/keys/data, redeploy with one click
Home redesign (bottom tab bar + full menu), PWA installable, designer icons
